test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No.5.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e.** 'Separate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"separate" **accurately reflects the action taken by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) to schedule the Summer and Winter Games in different years.
 
• **By placing the Games on separate four-year cycles**, the Winter Olympics and Summer Olympics occur in alternating even-numbered years, allowing each event to have its own dedicated year.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *but in accordance with a 1986 decision by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) to place the Summer and Winter Games on separate four-year cycles in alternating even-numbered years, the next Winter Olympics after 1992 was in 1994.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) "matching"** does not convey the idea of distinct cycles or separate scheduling. It suggests a similarity or correspondence, which is not the intended meaning in this context.
 
• **Option 2) "customary" **implies adherence to established customs or traditions, but it does not reflect the specific decision made by the IOC to separate the scheduling of the Summer and Winter Games.
 
• **Option 3) "together" **is the opposite of what the IOC intended to achieve. The aim was to schedule the Summer and Winter Games separately, not together.
